name: dumbbell hang power clean and jerk
description: A hang power clean followed by an overhead jerk. It is a full-body power move for hips, legs and shoulders.
instructions: Hold dumbbells hanging just above your knees with a flat back.
Explode up and pull the weights to your shoulders, catching in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then dip slightly with your knees.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the hang, and reset.
